note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles). Rockstar has never published the list itself. Kind and missable flags are this guide's own classification, derived from the official descriptions — not PSN data. Guides are written in this guide's own words from the official descriptions plus the public guides cited per trophy (PowerPyx's roadmap supplied the concrete counts, unlock conditions and tracking menus used here); where no public source has pinned down a method, the guide says so instead of guessing. Round 5: each guide is numbered steps; every step ends with [n] markers pointing at that trophy's numbered source list ([1] PowerPyx = concrete counts, unlock conditions and tracking menus; [2] Exophase + [3] PSNProfiles = the official name/description/grade facts they mirror). Steps that say no source has pinned a method down carry no marker. Positive Mental Attitude carries one open question with both readings shown.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task.
Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then robbery, money and misc cleanup.
The only trophy that can be missed is the Chapter 1 meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude), so guard that one and the platinum is a matter of hours, not luck.

trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Reach 100% completion — the checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts.
The requirements are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion.
The big numbers: any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK, study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, and any 70 of 80 challenges.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be finished in free roam after the story.
This is the longest grind in the game and the hardest trophy; budget roughly 100 hours for it after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida.

There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — mix them and pick the quickest; under-the-bridge flights are the fastest to rack up.
Track progress in the Progress menu under Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.
Note: the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

It is a skill grind, not a luck one, so expect several sessions; raising your Focus level (by playing ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots) also helps your aim elsewhere.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations.
You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location; track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The catch is Chapter 1: after the mission “Down to Earth”, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning, then walks to the balcony at Jason’s house.
Follow her, accept the prompt, and meditate — this adds +1 to the counter but is not listed as a meditation spot, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy.
Do it anyway, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops.
You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist.

dispute.question: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required for this trophy?
dispute.readingA: It counts: the balcony meditation raises the Meditations counter by +1, so doing it in Chapter 1 is part of reaching 18.
dispute.readingB: It may not count: the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the other 18, so the final meditation may count +2 instead and reach 18/18 without it.
dispute.note: Both readings come from PowerPyx (roadmap + meditation-spots page); every other guide checked agrees the requirement is still unconfirmed. Do the balcony meditation anyway — it costs nothing and removes the risk.

Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.target: Lose a 4-star wanted level with partner

steps.text: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.

Build four stars, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) is the easiest route, as the helicopter cannot see you on the tracks.
The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area.
It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”, since bank-vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then hit three robbery targets in a row (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, do not let it drop between shops.
Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline).
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs”: loot a few items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar (top left, under health and stamina).
Before you try, buff your focus — eat or drink, wash up at home, and use Adrenaline to extend the focus time (hold L1, press Triangle).
Then line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556.
Note: it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.
Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus) and rises as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots — by late game you will likely earn this naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.target: Steal a docked plane at VCIA and fly off

steps.text: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield.
The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to it, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside.
Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy pops once you are far enough out.

Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” — it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry-store robberies with green icons on unfogged map areas.
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it — that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe.
A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
Save first: one detection voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.when: After Chapter 4 — That’s Where The Money Is…

steps.text: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.

It starts with the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)”, which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner, as you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag).
After that mission, pay the fence Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first); the vans are marked with purple icons.
Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total and you need any 5 (all 8 for the 100% checklist); each pays up to $205,000, the best money in the endgame.

Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani’s shop after his quests.

Take the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City (a nod to the Banshee from GTA III).
You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs”: hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the showroom window.
The trophy pops a little after you drive away on the street, and it only unlocks from this blue Banshee — no other car counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.target: Steal all 3 valuables at Kingpin Bowling

steps.text: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it is a gang operation, and you first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”.

Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun “Gutterball Moreland 850” on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation to blow it).
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item.
If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a long while — you do not need all 3 in one visit, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Max strength with both Jason and Lucia

steps.text: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon).
You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, when you can switch between both characters.
Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon) or work out at home after the story.
Always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile.

Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): every time you do something that shifts your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen.

Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily builds a Professional profile; incapacitating without killing builds Hardened; killing builds Violent; large-scale killing builds Psycho; and excessive violence can leave you permanently Irredeemable — avoid that last one, as cops shoot on sight more often.
Most of the 500 happen passively while you chase the other trophies and the 100% checklist; if you are short at the end, any robbery or enemy encounter counts toward it.

The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job — so it comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)”.
It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere.
First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots for more registrations.
Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose “Respray” and “Register” in his garage.
At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay ’n’ Spray.
Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
